page.overview:
What is Battlefield?

This battlefield is a location within White Orchard. It is where Nilfgaardian and Temerian troops clashed in the Battle of White Orchard during the Third Northern War.

The territory is now covered with corpses and infested by necrophages such as ghouls and alghouls.
